AWS Bedrock returns 403 Forbidden (not 401) when credentials are missing, expired, or the IAM role lacks bedrock:InvokeModel permission — verifies the error is mapped to Authentication

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
begin
  api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
  client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
  result = client.chat_async(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(messages: [{ 'content' => 'Hello', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0'))
rescue StandardError => error
  warn "#{error.class}: #{error.message}"
end
```
